servers.access: Runs local analysis tooling on your own machine and reads the files and artifacts you point it at; it executes the REA toolchain locally, with no hosted component.
servers.description: Reverse-engineering toolkit — native binaries, managed and Electron apps, firmware, and web targets — exposed as MCP tools for agents.
servers.name: rea
servers.title: REA
servers.why: The engine behind this collection's reverse-engineer-anything pick, callable directly over MCP; the curator's own RE workhorse, in daily use.

servers.access: Acts on your GitHub account with your token's scopes — it can read and write anything that token can, so scope the token to the job.
servers.description: GitHub's official MCP server: repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions from any MCP client.
servers.name: github
servers.title: GitHub MCP Server
servers.why: The first-party reference integration — the fastest way to give an agent real, scoped GitHub access; this repo's own pipeline runs on it.
